main.description: A post in the feed (feed/posts). A Public post is stored in its author's repo, a Followers or Mutuals one in their app.activitytracker.space.athlete space for that tier; the AppView ignores one in self or interactions. The AppView accepts a post whose embed is a #proposal naming a feed.segmentNameProposal in the author's own repo with the post's record key, served only while that proposal is indexed, or a #quote of another feed.post with non-blank text (feed/quote-posts), served only to viewers who may also see the quoted post while it is served. Clients write one only by sharing a name proposal or by quoting a post.

text.description: The author's own words, such as why they propose the name. Required, and not blank, on a quote.

embed.description: What the post shares. An open union: later clients may add other kinds, which the AppView ignores until it knows them.

proposal.description: Shares a segment or dive site name proposal (segments/segment-names, dive-sites/site-names).

The app.activitytracker.feed.segmentNameProposal, in the post author's repo under the post's record key. A URI, not a strong ref: the post is written with the proposal, before its CID is known, and always shows the proposal's latest version.

quote.description: Quotes another post (feed/quote-posts). The quote's audience is no wider than the quoted post's, and it is shown only to viewers who may also see the quoted post while that is served.

subject.description: The quoted app.activitytracker.feed.post. The AppView ignores a quote of anything else.
